scope: Round two plant communities only; decorative animals deferred
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: round-two vegetation concept for the natural pixel-art pond game.
Input image is the EDIT TARGET: the previously selected A composition, 2048 x 768. Keep precisely the same wide 8:3 framing, all hills and valleys, rocks, fallen-log silhouette and location, camera, water color and soft light-beam directions. Do not redraw the composition or move any large forms. Add ONLY ecological PLANT COMMUNITIES to this exact terrain, matched to its pixel-art style.
Goal: a lush but readable natural freshwater pond bottom with varied botanical silhouettes, coherent habitat groups, and layered depth; not a row of identical thin stems. Pixel clusters and stepped edges, no smooth photorealistic illustration or blur. No repeating evenly-spaced clumps.
Place plants deliberately:
1. LEFT SLOPE FOOT around the broken stump: two unequal groups of tall slender ribbon-like grasses with gently curved leaves, plus lower broad oval/pointed leaf rosettes and short fine grass. Tall growth concentrated at extreme left, never a wall across the center. Keep the stump recognizable.
2. LOW TROUGH and small sediment depressions beneath and in front of the log: low soft carpet algae, loose short filamentous algae, tiny rooted rosette plants, sparse low grass; ground still visible between clusters, nothing floating above the soil.
3. LOG: several discontinuous soft dark green moss patches sitting on upper bark and branch joints; small epiphytic fern/leaf fans; a few short filament algae hang beneath the log. Keep at least 65% of the log's outline and wood grain exposed. Never cover it with a solid carpet.
4. RIGHT BOULDER and slope: low moss follows rock crevices; a compact broad-leaf patch rooted at the boulder's lower edge; a narrow uneven group of tall ribbon grass toward the extreme right edge. Keep the large boulder contour visible.
5. DEPTH: a few large but very faint blue-teal plant silhouettes at the left and right distant banks, with different spacing and heights. No repeated fern wallpaper. Darker close foreground vegetation may frame the very bottom corners, but stay short at center. Midground is muted olive-green; highlights restrained.
6. SURFACE: a handful of small broken groups of floating leaves along the TOP OUTER edges, fine unequal hanging roots at leftmost and rightmost edges, tapering in sparse clusters. Keep the broad center upper water and light paths open; no horizontal root curtain.
Readability exclusion: preserve almost unchanged clear low-detail water across x=25–78% and y=15–58%, and a continuous open swimming corridor above the log. No plants behind that central player/food band. Flora should add richness mainly at edges and in lower third, with varied density, NOT fill every empty patch. No bright pale speckles that resemble bait crumbs, no luminous dots.
NO animals of any kind: no fish, shrimp, snail, insect, shell creature. NO characters, food, hook, fishing line, UI, labels, text, border or watermark. These are later rounds or test overlays. Output just the edited full landscape in the exact original 2048 x 768 aspect ratio.
